- Short office-hours: 30–45 minute slot where we can take questions from your engineers (I can bring a couple of engineers).
- Quick 20m sync focusing on topology + cost/latency numbers — good for stakeholders who only need the highlights.
- Async option: we can send a focused recording of the demo + a short integration snippet and follow up on Slack/email.

If you’re open, here are three 2-hour office-hours blocks this week where we can handle multiple questions and drop into your infra:  
- Fri 4/16 — 09:00–11:00 PT
- Mon 4/19 — 13:00–15:00 PT
- Tue 4/20 — 08:00–10:00 PT

Or pick a single 20m slot via my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/novablue-demo

Thanks for the quick note and totally get the calendar constraints. We’d be happy to run an office-hours style session that’s targeted at platform/infra questions. Practical options:

2) Focused 20-minute sync: we’ll cover latency, cost per token/embedding, quantization impact, and required infra changes. Good for decision makers.

3) Async: we’ll record a 12–15 minute targeted walkthrough and include a 2–3 file integration snippet you can send to your team.

I’ve provisionally blocked the Fri 4/16 09:00–11:00 PT slot on our side and created another option Mon 4/19 13:00–15:00 PT. If neither works, reply with two 30-minute windows and we’ll match.
